title: Research audit: quadratic factor-tape travel for balanced dirty words
body:
PR985 gives a conservative O(r³ W_total) allowance for sequential factor lookup. This research audit proves that its unchanged balanced word admits quadratic factor-tape travel under an explicit contiguous, fixed-width layout.

For every n ≥ 1 and both call directions, the closed index travel is less than 2N, where N = 3qn − 2q² and q = 2^floor(log2 n). A reader that copies every B-bit descriptor and restores its head uses fewer than 4NB descriptor-head moves and exactly NB payload reads. The complete lookup bound is P_layout + P_parse + O(G + N(B + log²(nB+2))); setup, parsing, common parameters, preflight, copies, and amortized control are explicit. The proof also gives the exact quadratic variation on powers of two.

This refines a safe access allowance, not a false predecessor theorem. Preparation, numerical precision, arithmetic, mutable-array routing, recursive children, and physical/compiler obligations remain paid separately. It does not certify PR1054's complete invoice, improve the selected κ, or claim a measured runtime gain.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/balanced-descriptor-travel/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_DESCRIPTOR_PACKAGE` with a nested `PASS_BALANCED_DESCRIPTOR_TRAVEL` receipt.

- 150,126 actual lookups from the byte-exact PR985 dispatcher across 78 signed cases; two further cases vary array geometry.
- A separate compressed word algebra checks 4,241 counts. Literal bit-head and countdown models check 102 tape cases and 1,025 counter cases.
- Nine mathematical/tape controls and five package faults reject. The full audit passes from a read-only relocated copy.
- All five vendor files match their pinned Git blobs. Selected-record integrity and all 25 selected-result tests pass. CPython 3.15.0, standard library only.

The all-size claim rests on the written induction and paid reader construction. The main dispatcher fixtures use length-one arrays and zero coefficients to exercise the fixed dispatch structure; these are not numerical precision tests. Independent checking means separate implementations/models, not independent human review. Full repository/cold supplier replay, hosted CI, and formal verification of the multiplication theorem are not claimed.

## Scope and attribution

Only `research/balanced-descriptor-travel/` is added. The publication base is `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`; the experiment source is PR985 `da1cdf8ed4ac9b1b8378dfec73f77ff4e81a4f70`. PR1054, PR1085, PR1135, and discussion1202 concern different precision, magnitude, or representation questions.
